text:
Priya: Customer (Shoply) reporting sudden spike of 503s on /v1/generate (hosted) starting ~2026-03-16T14:20Z. They say it impacts ~5% of requests and is intermittent. SDK v1.3.2. Example request and small repro attached below.

Priya: Repro curl they ran:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":256}' -v
```

Maya: Confirming — our team sees same 503s from multiple regions (us-west, eu-west). No pattern on prompt size, sometimes small prompts fail.

Nate: I pulled edge logs for their tenant ts=4820001200-4820002000. Gateway p95 spikes from 180ms -> 900ms then 503s. Backend pool showed queue depth hitting batching threshold and then errors. Linking grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/d/Jz/batcher-queue?orgId=1

Lee: Thanks. Can you paste the batcher metrics snapshot (batch size, inflight, queue_wait) and the runtime error traces? Suspect lock-starve on kvcache when concurrent prefix cache misses align, causing batcher to stall and return 503 under our safety path.

Priya: Adding logs snippet from the request id 0a7f1c:
```
[2026-03-16T14:22:13Z] request_id=0a7f1c gateway=ingress queue_wait_ms=512 batch_size=1 runtime_err="batcher: queue timeout" status=503
```

Nate: Confirmed. Queue_wait_MS > 500 and batch_size=1 repeatedly. That points to many small requests starving batching windows and hitting queue timeout. Could be client side retry fanout too. Any SDK versions with aggressive retry/backoff misconfig?

Priya: Customer uses default SDK 1.3.2 with exponential backoff. They said they observed a client loop earlier where app retried on 503 without jitter.

Maya: We did deploy a retry patch yesterday that retries immediately on 5xx in some hot paths — will roll that back and test.

Lee: Meanwhile, mitigation suggestions for Shoply: 1) Add jitter to retries and cap concurrent outstanding requests; 2) Increase client-side timeout to 30s to avoid duplicate retries; 3) Use the batch-friendly endpoint param: "prefer_batching": true (temporary). Sample SDK config:
```js
client.options = {timeout:30000, max_inflight:8, retry: {maxAttempts:3, jitter:true}}
```

Priya: I posted the above to the customer as immediate steps and asked them to rollback the immediate-retry change. They were able to revert and said they saw a reduction but still some 503s.

Nate: I'm instrumenting a flip in the gateway to widen batch window by +20ms for the affected tenant to reduce single-item batches. Will monitor. @Lee can you watch runtime logs for kv lock traces?

Lee: Watching. I also created an internal debug job to replay a controlled load from us-west that mirrors Shoply's pattern. If we reproduce, we'll patch the batcher to fast-path small requests and avoid queue timeout fallback. Created issue INF-4321.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4321: "batcher queue timeouts under retry-fanout from SDK immediate retries" and assigned to eng-runtime.

ops-bot: Temporarily widened batch window for tenant shoply-prod. Observing 1m.

Priya: Customer update sent: asked for SDK rollback, applied client mitigations, and told them we are doing deeper runtime work. They asked for ETA — I gave tentative 48h pending reproduction.

Maya: Thanks team, will keep monitoring. Please leave this open until we get root cause and patch.

Priya: Will follow up. Escalating to eng-runtime (Lee) for RCA and long-term fix. Will update customer when we have patch. :thumbsup:
